config.executablePath: Absolute path to the pi-web server entry: a standalone server.js or the bin/pi-web.js inside the package. Leave empty for automatic resolution: built-in → global npm install → managed runtime.
config.package: The pi-web package name used for managed/global install lookups (must be the build with IDE integration patches, not upstream pi-web).
config.workspaceRoot: Project directory (cwd) passed to pi-web sessions. Leave empty to use the current workspace folder.
config.openBeside: Open the Pi for IDE panel in the adjacent column instead of the active one.
config.port: Preferred starting port for the Pi for IDE server (default 3030). If occupied, the next free port is used.
config.autoStart: Start the local pi-web server in the background when the extension activates (before the panel is first opened). Keep off if unused to avoid a resident process.
description: Pi for IDE — VSCode-native editor experience for pi coding agent. Full pi-web GUI (chat, sessions, model/MCP config, themes, etc.) plus deep VSCode integration: @ file mentions, context-menu mentions, active-file context, per-turn file review cards with inline diffs and one-click revert, clipboard bridge, etc.
config.autoStop: Let the extension-spawned pi-web server exit on its own after every window/client disconnects (server-side watchdog). The process then shuts down once no heartbeat or open page remains. Servers started standalone outside the IDE are never affected.
config.autoStopAfterSec: Seconds of full silence (no heartbeat, no open client) before an extension-spawned server exits. Applies only when autoStop is on. Minimum 90 — hidden browser tabs can only poll about once a minute.
config.checkForUpdates: Check the npm registry for a newer pi-web package once after activation and offer to upgrade.
